card.name: K4-free graphs without independent 6-sets (Ramsey number R(4,6))

task.name: K4-free graphs without independent 6-sets (Ramsey number R(4,6))
task.description: construct() -> {'n': n, 'edges': [[u, v], ...]}: a simple graph on vertices 0..n-1 with 1 <= n <= 40. It must contain no K4 and no independent set of 6 vertices, checked exactly. Maximize n. A valid graph on n vertices certifies R(4,6) > n. Exoo's 35-vertex graph is the published record; 36 vertices would be a new lower bound.
